She gestures near a metal holder with cupcake lollipops and a tiered stand with strawberry-topped cakes. A red berry centerpiece sits on the table. Large cardboard cupcake cutouts in pink and white frame the scene on either side against a white background. A "ShinDigZ" logo is in the corner. She clasps hands at chest, opens palms inward, speaks while facing the camera, and points to the stand.
[14-20] Camera cuts to close-up of the white two-tiered stand. Cupcakes in red and white striped wrappers read "Happy Holidays," topped with strawberries resembling Santa hats. Festive greenery, red berries, and silver ornaments surround the base of the stand. "ShinDigZ" logo visible in the bottom right corner.
[20-24] Camera cuts back to wide shot. The woman looks down at the stand, smiles broadly showing teeth, then closes her mouth to a neutral expression. Background elements remain stationary throughout.
